coverage: Tested · explicitly named BTC variant of archived martingale

The title and source symbol list name BTC, while the embedded exchange currency is a placeholder. Twelve complete BTC benchmarks and twelve latency runs cover the last, sole operative main declaration.
Tested · explicitly named BTC variant of archived martingale

Malformed stored market metadata names BTC, ETH and BCH. The operative main uses a single injected venue object and never rotates or consults other markets. BTC named variant completed twelve benchmarks and twelve latency runs, preserving full source behavior for that market.
Tested · original native settings, no fills

Two native FMZ sessions completed with 72,000 originally authored 100 BTC short attempts rejected, no buy attempts and no fills. Native balance remained 10,000 USDT. Positive lower-bound initial margin exceeds the available wallet in both sessions.

semantics.market_scope: Two cold-start four-hour dates, 2021-05-01 and 2021-06-01. Both are inside the archived source backtest horizon. The #5147 and #5149 results use the explicitly named BTC variant. ETH, BCH, LTC or EOS configurations remain outside this evidence. The original metadata fields for #5147 and #5149 require a human choice of a named market.
semantics.source_scope: The last declaration of main is the executable entry point under JavaScript function declaration rules. The original JS bytes run unchanged. Older SetCurrency and exchange.IO declarations are overwritten. The sandbox runner exposes no multi-venue, HTTP or source order-mode changing APIs. Native and recorded paths call a single symbol originally named by the publisher.
semantics.fees_and_risk: Use 0.04% historic taker fees and exact observed full-depth sweeps, 50x source leverage, and external Binance funding rates when positions are held. Native control verifies nearest 0.001 BTC quantity handling and the 10,000 USDT default wallet. Snapshot causal support, funding, cash and marked drawdown are checked against independent Decimal accounting.
semantics.rng: Three xorshift32 seeds and their antithetic counterparts are explicit, reproducible draws for the stochastic source. Primary and 200ms delayed paths share the same historical dates. Original random seeds are not recoverable. #5150 overwrites its initial random direction with the published Boolean flags, making all flat attempts identical in side and quantity.
semantics.proof_limits: Native no-fills for #5150 apply to these windows and the archived default cash. Zero trades gives no win rate signal. Recorded-market fills remain modeled, using publicly captured displayed levels and fixed order timing. Delayed paths are full separate causal replays.
